Messages.Author: pallando
Messages.Body:
Hi,

What happends nowadays when Talaq plays Burst of Sunlight?

I remember a time when he didn't take any damage from it. Then the
ruling was that he plays it as a vampire and takes 1 agg, effectively
burning him. Is this ruling still valid?

Kind regards,

pallando

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


He takes 1 agg damage, but treats it as an ally treats agg damage -
i.e. burns one life.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes.
If he plays the card as a vampire, it (the play of the card) sees him
as a vampire.
It only burns him if it leaves him with no life, however.
